items.source:

applies.
items.translation: 如果给定的请求谓词适用，则路由到内置的路由器函数。

items.source: Route requests that match the given predicate to the given resource.

items.source:

items.translation: 使用提供的查找函数路由到资源。

items.source: Provides the types that make up Spring's functional web framework for Reactive environments.
items.translation: 提供构成 Spring 用于 Reactive 环境的函数式 Web 框架的类型。

items.source: Adds the given route to this builder.
items.translation: 将给定的路由添加到此构建器中。

items.source:
Filter the response object for all routes created by this builder
with the given response processing function.
items.translation: 使用给定的响应处理函数，过滤此构建器创建的所有路由的响应对象。

items.source:
Filter the request object for all routes created by this builder with
the given request processing function.
items.translation: 使用给定的请求处理函数，过滤由该构建器创建的所有路由的请求对象。

items.source:
Filters all routes created by this builder with the given filter
function.
items.translation: 使用给定的过滤函数过滤此构建器创建的所有路由。

items.source:
Route to the supplied router function if the given request predicate
applies.
items.translation: 如果给定的请求谓词适用，则路由到提供的路由器函数。

items.source:
Filters all exceptions of the given type by applying the
given response provider function.
items.translation: 通过应用给定的响应提供器函数，过滤所有给定类型的异常。

items.source:
Filters all exceptions that match the predicate by applying the
given response provider function.
items.translation: 通过应用给定的响应提供器函数，过滤所有匹配谓词的异常。

items.source:
Route to the supplied router function if the given path prefix
pattern applies.
items.translation: 如果给定的路径前缀模式适用，则路由到提供的路由器函数。

items.source:
Adds a route to the given handler function that handles all
requests that match the given predicate.
items.translation: 向给定的处理函数添加一条路由，该路由处理所有匹配给定谓词的请求。

items.source:
Offers a discoverable way to create router functions through
a WebFlux builder-style interface.
items.translation: 通过 WebFlux 构建器风格的接口，提供了一种可发现的方式来创建路由器函数。

items.source: Add an attribute  to the last route built with this builder.
items.translation: 向使用此构建器构建的最后一个路由添加一个属性。

items.source: Manipulate the attributes of the last route built.
items.translation: 操纵最后构建的路由的属性。
